[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] owned a [[Green (disambiguation)|green]]-bladed '''lightsaber''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Built under the tutelage of the ancient droid [[Huyang/Legends|Professor Huyang]] when she was a very young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], after returning from securing her [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], the lightsaber blade was a brilliant green. Tano used the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in many battles of the Clone Wars, such as [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]], [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]], [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. She later wielded a [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber shoto]] alongside it.

==History==
[[File:SWEAhsokaTano.png|thumb|left|250px|Ahsoka Tano wields her two lightsabers]]
As Jedi own so few possessions, Ahsoka was very attached to her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and so was most upset when it was stolen from her by a [[Patrolian]] [[Bannamu/Legends|pickpocket]]. The lightsaber was sold to a notorious criminal named [[Nack Movers/Legends|Nack Movers]], only to have it stolen by [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]] after she killed him. After chasing Cryar across rooftops and a train, Ahsoka managed to retrieve her lightsaber with the help of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]], who urged her to use her experience to remind a class of younglings of the importance of the lightsaber to their owners.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> She would use this lightsaber while focusing on [[Form IV/Legends|Form IV]] and [[Form V/Legends|Form V]] lightsaber combat. She was notable in that she, unlike most other Jedi, wielded it in a reverse [[Form V/Legends|Shien]] style grip.

Later in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]], she crafted a yellowish-green [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|Lightsaber shoto]] to pair with this blade and wielded it during many battles across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] such as [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]], [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] and [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Tano lost both lightsabers when she was forced to go on the run; she dropped her shoto when a rocket blast knocked her over<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> and her original lightsaber while [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueling]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="To Catch a Jedi">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref> Ultimately losing her faith in the Jedi Order, she left that life behind, departing without either of her lightsabers.<ref name="Wrong">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>
